visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor living room. A young man with short black hair and a black t-shirt sits at a white table, holding a red hair dryer in his right hand and a champagne-gold hair dryer in his left. Next to him, a young woman with long reddish-brown hair looks at the camera. Behind them is a white wall with an air conditioning unit and a framed picture. (2) The man begins demonstrating the hair dryers. A smartphone on a red stand is placed on the table, showing a countdown timer. He holds the gold hair dryer and begins drying the woman's wet hair. The woman holds the red hair dryer, gesturing toward it. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the hair. (3) Close-up shots show the man's hands as he runs his fingers through the woman's hair while using the gold dryer. The camera alternates between medium shots of the duo and close-ups of the hair texture and the gold hair dryer's nozzle. The woman reacts with smiles and facial expressions indicating satisfaction. (4) The video transitions to a series of product-focused shots. The champagne-gold Panasonic hair dryer is shown against a plain white background. Close-ups highlight the 'nanocare' logo, the control buttons, and the various mode indicator lights (Hot, Cold, Scalp, Skin). The man's hands are seen operating the device and applying it to the woman's hair at different angles. (5) In the final phase, the man and woman are back in the original setting, talking to the camera. The man points to the camera while the woman looks on. A brief black-and-white stylized segment appears at the very end, showing a playful reaction before the screen cuts to the final call-to-action overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic male voice introducing the content over an upbeat, moderate-tempo electronic BGM. A subtle digital click SFX occurs during text transitions. (2) As the hair dryer starts, a loud, broadband white noise (wind noise) enters the mix, layered under the narrator's enthusiastic speech. The BGM remains steady with a driving synth beat. (3) Short 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects accentuate various on-screen variety text and editing cuts. The woman's laughter and short vocal interjections are heard during the comparison. (4) The wind noise cuts out during product feature explanations. The male voice becomes more clinical and narrative, describing technical specs. The BGM volume swells slightly during transitions between modes. (5) The video concludes with a humorous dialogue segment followed by a stylized gunshot SFX and a final fade-out of the music and vocals.
